comment: Season balance report (O398, server/tools/balance_report.py; server/README.md "Season balance report (O398)"). tolerance: a class is flagged when its minutes per level or damage per hour is this share away from the median of its level band; deathTolerance: the same for deaths per hunting hour; minDeathsPerHour: no death flag below this rate; minHuntHours / minCharacterHours: a class and band needs this much hunting time (and this many character-hours: the small groups rule) to be compared; minClasses: a band needs this many compared classes for a median; suggestShare / suggestMax: a suggested change is this share of the gap, at most suggestMax; bandLevel: the level each telemetry band (telemetry_config.lua bands) is measured at; topSpells: most used spells per class; autoDays: the timer writes the report of a season that ended within this many days; keep: saved reports kept; defaultDays: the window without --days or --season.
